title: Whether a bargain can be paid personally by the player isn't consistent or predictable. Thornwold's toll offered 'pay the old toll yourself (12 gold)' outright. Fenmarch's tithe, when it came due, only offered 'let the eel-market pay it as promised' or 'tell Halm the water can whistle for it' — there was no option to cover it from my own purse, even though I was standing right there with gold on hand.
where: The Quartermaster's Wagon (Camp Gallows) vs. The Priory of the Gray Church, 'the first tithe' dialogue
